architecture.frontend: A React single-page PC client renders the single age-entry page at /page/page-age-entry with a side navigation layout, enabled header, disabled footer, and no authentication. It communicates with the backend through REST JSON APIs and performs client-side validation before submission.
architecture.backend: 后端技术栈固定为 Java8 + Springboot，提供真实 HTTP API、资源接口和业务契约实现。
architecture.data: 数据库固定使用 MySQL8，缓存固定使用 Redis。
